description: One authority in full: the user's notes and analysis, every saved quotation with its pincite, the projects it is filed under, how they connected it to other authorities (related), and any captured source text available for it. Search and list rows already carry a summary, so reach for this when you need the whole note, the quotations, or those connections -- not to identify a case.
